svg.title: No record or grade below expected level
svg.desc: No record or grade below expected level. Modern definition. Adjusted descriptive difference (pp): no record the next year or grade below expected progression. Unknown grade excluded. Nominal uncertainty intervals: annual 95%; pooled 98.75%. 2016: +9.1 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2017: +2.0 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2018: +3.8 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2019: +8.0 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2020: +3.4 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2021: +3.0 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2022: +10.8 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2023: +3.6 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2024: +1.9 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; pooled: +5.0 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI. Period-specific scale; do not compare lengths across panels. † Weak precision or no valid interval.
